# Multi-Agent Orchestrator

> A multi-agent orchestrator built from scratch: a planner decomposes a goal, specialized workers execute subtasks, and a critic verifies, coordinated over a shared blackboard.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator

## Source

- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/__init__.py): Multi-Agent Orchestrator - planner, workers, and a critic over a blackboard.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/agents.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/agents.py): Deterministic, offline built-in agents.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/agents_extra.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/agents_extra.py): A tool-using worker and additional planners.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/baseline.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/baseline.py): A single-agent baseline for comparison.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/cli.py): Command-line interface for the multi-agent orchestrator.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/comparison.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/comparison.py): An honest single-agent vs multi-agent comparison over multi-step workloads.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/consensus.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/consensus.py): Consensus coordination: many workers answer the same task, then aggregate.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/core/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/core/__init__.py): Core abstractions for multi-agent orchestration.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/core/agents.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/core/agents.py): Agent roles as protocols.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/core/blackboard.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/core/blackboard.py): The shared blackboard: the single source of truth for a run.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/core/types.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/core/types.py): Core types for multi-agent coordination.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/durable.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/durable.py): Durable orchestration: checkpoint the blackboard and resume an interrupted run.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/graph.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/graph.py): Dependency-graph validation.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/memory.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/memory.py): Shared memory for agents.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/metrics.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/metrics.py): Metrics over an orchestrated run.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/orchestrator.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/orchestrator.py): The orchestrator: the coordination loop over planner, workers, and critic.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the orchestrator.
- [src/multi_agent_orchestrator/trace.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/multi-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/src/multi_agent_orchestrator/trace.py): Serializing an orchestrated run to JSON.
